title: add georgia data
description:
Aims to close #17. @graysonwhite, could I have you come in to bat here?

I _believe_ the untracked rasters I have are only for Washington, and I thiiiink that's likely the cause of the missingness I'm seeing here. Here's some notes on my attempt to convert your script that grabs the data for Washington to Georgia.

----


After a few failed attempts to update the script to use the newest FIESTA API, I used:

```r
pak::pak(c(
  "USDAForestService/FIESTA@v3.6.4",
  "USDAForestService/FIESTAutils@c3f6331"
))
```

...which were the up-to-date versions when Grayson wrote this script last year.

In the call to `spGetAuxiliary()`, I see:

title: Change naming pattern of remote sensing predictors
description: Prompted by #1, here is a suggestion to discuss: I changed the naming pattern for some of the remote sensing predictors to make them easier to group, e.g. all temperature variables start with `temp`, the vapor ones with `vapor` etc. That makes them a little less like English but easier to use selectors on, should we want to do that later on (or in a different context).
